assistant.text: I'll help you with this request. Let me first fetch both reservations to check the booking timestamps and determine what can be cancelled according to the policy.

Now let me check the current time and calculate if each reservation is within the 24-hour cancellation window:

- Current time: 2026-09-06 08:00 UTC
- R-2002 booked at: 2026-09-05 07:45 UTC → 24 hours later would be 2026-09-06 07:45 UTC
  - Current time (08:00 UTC) is AFTER 07:45 UTC, so this is outside the 24-hour window
- R-2003 booked at: 2026-09-05 08:30 UTC → 24 hours later would be 2026-09-06 08:30 UTC
  - Current time (08:00 UTC) is BEFORE 08:30 UTC, so this is within the 24-hour window

I can cancel R-2003 free of charge, but R-2002 cannot be cancelled (it's outside the 24-hour window and basic economy reservations can only be cancelled within 24 hours of booking).

input.text: We've processed your cancellation requests. Reservation R-2003 (DEN to LAX on 2026-10-07) has been cancelled free of charge. However, reservation R-2002 (LAX to DEN on 2026-10-03) cannot be cancelled because it's outside the 24-hour cancellation window allowed for basic economy fares. Basic economy reservations can only be cancelled within 24 hours of booking, and R-2002 was booked on September 5th at 07:45 UTC.

assistant.text: Done! I've successfully cancelled reservation R-2003 free of charge. Reservation R-2002 could not be cancelled because it's outside the 24-hour cancellation window for basic economy fares—it was booked on September 5th at 07:45 UTC, which is more than 24 hours ago. The passenger has been notified of both results.
